SIXTH AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement by and between
Mr. Amjed All ("Sub-lessor") and Zameen Media (private) Limited ("Sub-lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This sixth amendment ("Sixth Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 2nd January, 2020, further
June, 2020, Second Amendment dated 2' April, 2021, Third
amended through First Amendment dated
Amendment dated 29th March, 2022, Fourth Amendment dated 28th March, 2023 and Fifth Amendment
Dated 11th March 2024 (collectively referred to as the "Lease Agreement"), is made and entered into at
Lahore on this

March, 2025.
WHEREAS

(A)

The Parties entered into the Lease Agreement wherein the Sub-lessor granted on lease, and the
Sub-lessee took on lease from the Sub-lessor, 2 basement of Ali Tower, 99/100-B-i M.M Alam
Road Gulberg Lahore ("Premises"); and

(B)

Pursuant to Clause 4 (b) of the Lease Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to further
revise and amend the Lease Agreement as per the provisions of this Sixth Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Sixth Amendment shall be effective from the l April, 2025 ("Effective Date").

2.

The Term of the Lease Agreement is hereby extended for a period of one (1) year, commencing
from the Effective Date and ending on 315t March, 2026 ("Extended Term").

3.

During the Extended Term, the Sub-lessee shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 180,000 (Rupees One
Hundred Eighty Thousand Only) exclusive of taxes ("Monthly Rent") to the Sub-lessor against
parking of sixty (60) vehicles at the area of 7680 (Seven Thousand Six Hundred Eighty) sq.ft.

4.

The Sub-lessor shall provide an additional parking space for five (5) vehicles measuring 640 sq.ft.
without any additional charge or expense whatsoever. For the avoidance of doubt, the Sub-lessor
shall provide a total parking space for sixty-five (65) vehicles at an area measuring 8320 (Eight
Thousand Three Hundred Twenty) sq.ft.

5.

Either Party may terminate the Lease Agreement, during the Extended Term, by serving one (1)
months' notice in writing to the other Party.

6.

The Sixth Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Lease Agreement.

7.

All other terms and provisions in the Lease Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis, and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of
any conflict, the provisions of this Sixth Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the
Lease Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Lease Agreement shall bear the same meaning in

9.

This Sixth Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Sixth Amendment, having fully understood
the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
